capabilities: embed editable spreadsheets in notes via code blocks
load data from existing XLSX, XLS, or CSV files
save sheet changes to external files or back to the code block
preserve formatting when saving to code blocks or XLSX
enable file saving at vault or code-block level
extras: README notes that saving to external files is disabled by default due to loss of information, and that reading existing XLSX files supports only a subset of functionality; XLS support is limited to data and cell merges.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or edit spreadsheet-like tabular data inside notes or work with Excel and CSV files directly.
summary: Spreadsheet plugin that embeds editable sheets in notes via code blocks, storing data inline or in external XLSX, XLS, or CSV files.
